passage.label: When hypocrites come you Muhammad say testify Messenger Allah; Allah knows you are His Messenger testifies hypocrites liars; taken oaths cover averted people way Allah evil doing; because believed then disbelieved hearts sealed over not understand; when see them forms please you speak listen speech like pieces wood propped up think every shout against them enemy beware them may Allah destroy them how deluded

arabicExcerpts.text: إِذَا جَآءَكَ ٱلۡمُنَٰفِقُونَ قَالُواْ نَشۡهَدُ إِنَّكَ لَرَسُولُ ٱللَّهِۗ وَٱللَّهُ يَعۡلَمُ إِنَّكَ لَرَسُولُهُۥ وَٱللَّهُ يَشۡهَدُ إِنَّ ٱلۡمُنَٰفِقِينَ لَكَٰذِبُونَ
ٱتَّخَذُوٓاْ أَيۡمَٰنَهُمۡ جُنَّةٗ فَصَدُّواْ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِۚ إِنَّهُمۡ سَآءَ مَا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ
ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمۡ ءَامَنُواْ ثُمَّ كَفَرُواْ فَطُبِعَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمۡ فَهُمۡ لَا يَفۡقَهُونَ

۞وَإِذَا رَأَيۡتَهُمۡ تُعۡجِبُكَ أَجۡسَامُهُمۡۖ وَإِن يَقُولُواْ تَسۡمَعۡ لِقَوۡلِهِمۡۖ كَأَنَّهُمۡ خُشُبٞ مُّسَنَّدَةٞۖ يَحۡسَبُونَ كُلَّ صَيۡحَةٍ عَلَيۡهِمۡۚ هُمُ ٱلۡعَدُوُّ فَٱحۡذَرۡهُمۡۚ قَٰتَلَهُمُ ٱللَّهُۖ أَنَّىٰ يُؤۡفَكُونَ

mainSubject.label: Hypocrites approaching the Prophet with verbal testimony that he is Allah's Messenger while Allah confirms his messengership and testifies they lie; their oaths used as cover to avert people from Allah's way, named as evil conduct rooted in belief followed by disbelief producing sealed hearts incapable of understanding; their pleasing appearance and eloquent speech masking hollow interiors like propped-up timber, paranoid that every cry targets them, identified as the enemy requiring vigilance, cursed with the question of how they remain deluded
